comparator.name: Bachelor Applied Mathematics
comparator.sourceNotes: Fresh current 2026–2027 Mathematics and Computer Science after-revision PER, Articles 3.3–3.5 and Appendix 2 Applied Mathematics table p.78, establishes the ordinary English full-time single-degree curriculum. Twenty-eight credited positions total 60 + 60 + 60 = 180: core 125 including ordinary 2MBB10 Bachelor Final Project exactly 10, ITEC 10 and genuine open electives 45 (15 in year two, 30 in year three). Current Calculus for Applied Mathematics 2MCALCAM replaces 2WCB0 for September-2026 entrants under Appendix 3 p.90; no extra calculus is added. No formal specialization is required; select the broad ordinary pathway independently of UCR fit. Article 3.4 permits an alternative interdisciplinary Innovation Space final project of 15 EC by derogation; this is an optional alternative, not an extra requirement or a generic 10/15/20 range. The ordinary 10-credit final project spans two quarter positions and counts once. SCOP/e 2PRV21/2PRV22 and PPD are embedded; core CBL subparts add no credits. MyFuture requires value seven with no EC; at least five Studium Generale activities are part of ITEC requirements. Open electives require examination-board approval, no substantive overlap and at least 30 EC at levels 2/3 including 15 at level 3. BEP entry requires at least 120 credits including all compulsory first-year units; the 95-BCS-credit rule belongs to Computer Science, not Applied Mathematics. Multidisciplinary CBL requires completion of offered PPD-containing components. Detailed course assessment conditions and future timetabling remain applicable catalogue conditions. No new UCR judgment is made.
